Peripartum Cardiomyopathy: Presented 5 months after an uneventful full-term spontaneous vaginal delivery followed by tubal ligation
No previous history of cardiovascular disease
Chest x-ray showed moderate cardiomegaly and prominent bibasilar interstitial markings
severe epigastric and right upper quadrant abdominal pain

thickened anterior gall bladder wall without stones or sludge
severe, worsening right upper quadrant and epigastric pain
left lower extremity and back pains
